  • Method Details

    • register

      RmiPlayerSession register(String nickname, RmiClient client, int numPlayers, String totemColour) throws RemoteException
      Registers a client by assigning it automatically to an open session with the requested player count, or by creating a new session.
      Returns:
      the remote player-session stub, or null if the join was rejected; in that case the server also sends an error message to the client callback
      Throws:
      RemoteException

    • registerWithSession

      RmiPlayerSession registerWithSession(String nickname, RmiClient client, int numPlayers, String totemColour, String sessionId) throws RemoteException
      Like register(String, RmiClient, int, String), but joins the specific session identified by sessionId. If sessionId is null or blank, this behaves like register(String, RmiClient, int, String).
      Returns:
      the remote player-session stub, or null if the join was rejected
      Throws:
      RemoteException

    • listSessions

      List<Message.SessionInfo> listSessions(int numPlayersFilter) throws RemoteException
      Returns the list of open sessions. Call this before registerWithSession(String, RmiClient, int, String, String) to show available games.
      Parameters:
      numPlayersFilter - if greater than 0, filters by player count; 0 returns all sessions
      Throws:
      RemoteException
